C0971.title: Highlight Reel of Toxic Player Behavior: Intentional Feeding and Throwing in Ranked Matches
C0971.summary: A video compilation showcases various instances of intentional feeding by players in ranked matches of a multiplayer online battle arena game. These disruptive behaviors include deliberately running into enemy towers and avoiding any effective gameplay, aiming to ruin the gaming experience and match outcome for their own team.
